ventas AS (

)

argumentos.sql:
WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock_total
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd
),
dem AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u90
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch <= c.f AND v.vta_fch > c.f - 90
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
prop AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst, a.art_crt,
         CEIL(COALESCE(d.u90,0)::numeric / 90 * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE s.stock_total < a.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty * art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto FROM prop

SELECT (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) FROM vtadia) AS fecha_corte, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocpcab) AS n_oc, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst) AS n_art, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exidet) AS n_exi, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vtadia) AS n_vta

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM prop WHERE qty * art_cst > 100000

)

WITH v AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt,
         a.art_cst * COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd), 0) AS valor
  FROM artmst a
),
r AS (
  SELECT art_cd FROM v ORDER BY valor DESC, art_cd ASC
  LIMIT (SELECT CEIL(0.2 * COUNT(*)) FROM artmst)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM v
WHERE art_crt OR art_cd IN (SELECT art_cd FROM r)

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS total
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd
),
riesgo AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, s.total, COALESCE(v.u30,0)/30.0 AS dda, p.prv_dte
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
  JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true
    AND COALESCE(v.u30,0) > 0
    AND s.total / (COALESCE(v.u30,0)/30.0) < p.prv_dte
)
SELECT r.art_cd, r.total, r.dda, r.prv_dte, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = r.art_cd AND r.total > 0 AND e.exi_qty > 1.5 * r.total / 3.0) AS cedis_exc
FROM riesgo r ORDER BY r.art_cd

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock_total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) AS stock_total, vt.u30,
         COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) / (vt.u30 / 30.0) AS cobertura
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN ventas vt ON vt.vta_art = a.art_cd AND vt.u30 > 0
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cobertura)::numeric, 1) AS cobertura,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cobertura < 7) AS menos_7,
       COUNT(*) AS n_criticos_con_ventas
FROM base

WITH val AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0)*a.art_cst AS valor
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
), top AS (
  SELECT art_cd FROM val ORDER BY valor DESC, art_cd ASC LIMIT CEIL(0.2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst))
), clA AS (
  SELECT art_cd FROM val WHERE art_crt OR art_cd IN (SELECT art_cd FROM top)
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(valor),2) AS valor_total,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN art_cd IN (SELECT art_cd FROM clA) THEN valor ELSE 0 END) / SUM(valor), 1) AS pct_clase_a
FROM val

argumentos.sql:
WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr, a.art_crt, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock_total
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr, a.art_crt
),
dem AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS unid
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 89 AND c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
prop AS (
  SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_cst,
    CEIL(COALESCE(d.unid,0) / 90.0 * CASE WHEN s.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM stock s LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd
  WHERE s.stock_total < s.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty * art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto FROM prop

WITH t AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS tot FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art HAVING SUM(exi_qty) > 0) SELECT a.alm_dsc AS cedis, COUNT(*) AS skus_con_excedente FROM exidet e JOIN t ON t.exi_art = e.exi_art JOIN almmst a ON a.alm_id = e.exi_alm WHERE e.exi_qty > 1.5 * (t.tot / 3.0) GROUP BY a.alm_dsc ORDER BY skus_con_excedente DESC, a.alm_dsc
SELECT (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) FROM vtadia) AS corte, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocpcab) AS ocs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst) AS arts, (SELECT MIN(vta_fch) FROM vtadia) AS minf

  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr
),
dem AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u90
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch <= c.f AND v.vta_fch > c.f - 90
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
prop AS (
  SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_cst,
    CEIL(COALESCE(d.u90,0)/90.0 * CASE WHEN s.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM stock s LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd
  WHERE s.stock_total < s.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM prop WHERE qty * art_cst BETWEEN 50000 AND 250000

WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stk AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS tot FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art=a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
dem AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia v, c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art),
prop AS (
SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, s.tot, COALESCE(d.u,0)/90.0 AS avg90,
CEIL(COALESCE(d.u,0)/90.0 * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
FROM artmst a JOIN stk s ON s.art_cd=a.art_cd LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art=a.art_cd
WHERE s.tot < a.art_ptr AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art=a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED')))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM prop WHERE qty * art_cst > 100000

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst) AS catalogo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst WHERE art_crt IS TRUE) AS criticos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst WHERE art_cst IS NULL) AS sin_costo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exidet WHERE exi_qty IS NULL) AS qty_nulo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst WHERE art_crt IS NULL) AS crt_nulo

with c as (select max(vta_fch) as f from vtadia),
d as (select vta_art, sum(vta_und) as u from vtadia, c where vta_fch > c.f - 90 and vta_fch <= c.f group by vta_art)
select count(*) as n, count(*) filter (where a.art_ptr is null) as sin_ptr, count(*) filter (where p.prv_dte is null) as sin_lead
from artmst a left join prvmst p on p.prv_id=a.art_prv left join d on d.vta_art=a.art_cd
where a.art_ptr < ceil(coalesce(d.u,0)/90.0 * p.prv_dte * case when a.art_crt then 1.5 else 1.2 end)

argumentos.sql:
WITH valor AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) * a.art_cst AS val
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
top AS (
  SELECT art_cd FROM valor ORDER BY val DESC, art_cd ASC
  LIMIT (SELECT CEIL(0.2 * COUNT(*)) FROM artmst)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM valor
WHERE art_crt IS TRUE OR art_cd IN (SELECT art_cd FROM top)

with c as (select max(vta_fch) as f from vtadia),
d as (select vta_art, sum(vta_und) as u from vtadia, c where vta_fch > c.f - 90 and vta_fch <= c.f group by vta_art)
select count(*) as n
from artmst a left join prvmst p on p.prv_id=a.art_prv left join d on d.vta_art=a.art_cd
where a.art_ptr < coalesce(d.u,0)/90.0 * p.prv_dte * case when a.art_crt then 1.5 else 1.2 end
SELECT o.ocp_sts, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(o.ocp_qty * a.art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto FROM ocpcab o JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = o.ocp_art WHERE a.art_crt = true GROUP BY o.ocp_sts

WITH valor AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) * a.art_cst AS val
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
top AS (
  SELECT art_cd FROM valor ORDER BY val DESC, art_cd ASC
  LIMIT (SELECT CEIL(0.2 * COUNT(*)) FROM artmst)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM valor

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia), riesgo AS (SELECT a.art_cd FROM artmst a JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv LEFT JOIN (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock_total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art) s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd LEFT JOIN (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS und30 FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art) w ON w.vta_art = a.art_cd WHERE a.art_crt = true AND p.prv_pais = 'CN' AND COALESCE(w.und30,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) / (w.und30/30.0) < p.prv_dte) SELECT SUM(v.vta_und) AS unidades FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f AND v.vta_art IN (SELECT art_cd FROM riesgo)

Cutoff date = MAX(vta_fch) in vtadia.

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock_total
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd
),
venta AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) / 30.0 AS prom30
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, s.stock_total, COALESCE(vt.prom30,0) AS prom30
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN venta vt ON vt.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM base WHERE prom30 > 0 AND stock_total / prom30 < 7

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 29 AND c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art),
stock AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS s FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art)
SELECT a.art_cd AS sku, COALESCE(s.s,0) AS stock, v.u AS unidades_30d, p.prv_dte AS dias_entrega, ROUND(COALESCE(s.s,0)*30.0/v.u,2) AS cobertura_dias
FROM artmst a
JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true AND v.u > 0 AND COALESCE(s.s,0)*30.0/v.u < p.prv_dte
ORDER BY 1

stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stk FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
ven AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia v, c WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 29 AND c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero
FROM artmst a
CROSS JOIN c
LEFT JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN ven ON ven.vta_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true
  AND (COALESCE(s.stk,0) < a.art_ptr
       OR (COALESCE(ven.u,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(s.stk,0) * 30.0 < p.prv_dte * ven.u))

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas90 AS (
  SELECT vta_art, SUM(vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia, corte
  WHERE vta_fch > corte.f - 90 AND vta_fch <= corte.f GROUP BY vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock_total
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr, a.art_crt, s.stock_total,
         COALESCE(v.u,0)/90.0 AS dda
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN ventas90 v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE s.stock_total < a.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
),
props AS (
  SELECT art_cd, art_cst,
    CEIL(dda * CASE WHEN art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM base
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty * art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto, COUNT(*) AS n_skus, (SELECT f FROM corte) AS fecha_corte FROM props

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
v AS (SELECT vta_art AS art, SUM(vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia, corte WHERE vta_fch BETWEEN f - 29 AND f GROUP BY vta_art),
s AS (SELECT exi_art AS art, SUM(exi_qty) AS q FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art),
c AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(s.q,0) AS stock, v.u / 30.0 AS vd, COALESCE(s.q,0) / (v.u/30.0) AS cob
      FROM artmst a JOIN v ON v.art = a.art_cd LEFT JOIN s ON s.art = a.art_cd
      WHERE a.art_crt AND v.u > 0)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cob),1) AS cobertura, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN cob < 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS menos_7 FROM c

WITH sku AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0)*a.art_cst AS valor
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
rk AS (
  SELECT art_cd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY valor DESC, art_cd ASC) AS rn FROM sku
),
clA AS (
  SELECT s.art_cd FROM sku s JOIN rk ON rk.art_cd=s.art_cd
  WHERE s.art_crt OR rk.rn <= CEIL(0.2*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst))
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(valor),2) AS valor_total,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN art_cd IN (SELECT art_cd FROM clA) THEN valor ELSE 0 END)/SUM(valor),1) AS pct_clase_a,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clA) AS n_clase_a
FROM sku

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
v30 AS (
  SELECT vta_art, SUM(vta_und) AS und30
  FROM vtadia, corte
  WHERE vta_fch > corte.f - 30 AND vta_fch <= corte.f
  GROUP BY vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock_total
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd
)
SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, p.prv_pais, p.prv_dte, s.stock_total, COALESCE(v.und30,0) AS und30,
  ROUND(s.stock_total / NULLIF(COALESCE(v.und30,0)/30.0,0), 2) AS cobertura
FROM artmst a
JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN v30 v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true AND p.prv_pais = 'CN'
ORDER BY a.art_cd

SELECT e.exi_art AS articulo, e.exi_qty AS existencia, a.art_ptr AS punto_reorden
FROM exidet e
JOIN almmst l ON l.alm_id = e.exi_alm
JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = e.exi_art
WHERE l.alm_cdd = 'Guadalajara' AND e.exi_qty > 2 * a.art_ptr
ORDER BY e.exi_art

WITH t AS (
  SELECT a.art_lin AS categoria,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.alm_cdd = 'Monterrey' THEN e.exi_qty ELSE 0 END) AS uds_monterrey,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.alm_cdd = 'Guadalajara' THEN e.exi_qty ELSE 0 END) AS uds_guadalajara
  FROM exidet e
  JOIN almmst l ON l.alm_id = e.exi_alm
  JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = e.exi_art
  GROUP BY a.art_lin
)
SELECT categoria, uds_monterrey, uds_guadalajara
FROM t
WHERE uds_monterrey > uds_guadalajara
ORDER BY categoria

SELECT a.alm_id, a.alm_dsc, COUNT(*) AS skus_bajo_pto
FROM exidet e
JOIN almmst a ON a.alm_id = e.exi_alm
JOIN artmst r ON r.art_cd = e.exi_art
WHERE e.exi_qty < r.art_ptr
GROUP BY a.alm_id, a.alm_dsc
ORDER BY skus_bajo_pto DESC, a.alm_dsc ASC

SELECT a.alm_id, a.alm_dsc, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM exidet e

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS total
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd
),
dem AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS und
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch <= c.f AND v.vta_fch > c.f - 90
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
prop AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst, a.art_crt,
    CEIL(COALESCE(d.und,0)/90.0 * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE s.total < a.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty * art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto FROM prop
SELECT COUNT(*) AS filas, COUNT(DISTINCT ocp_art) AS arts, MIN(ocp_fcr), MAX(ocp_fcr) FROM ocpcab

WITH t AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS tot FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art HAVING SUM(exi_qty) > 0),
s AS (SELECT e.exi_art, e.exi_alm, SUM(e.exi_qty) AS q FROM exidet e GROUP BY e.exi_art, e.exi_alm)
SELECT a.alm_dsc AS cedis, COUNT(*) AS skus_con_excedente
FROM s JOIN t ON t.exi_art = s.exi_art JOIN almmst a ON a.alm_id = s.exi_alm
WHERE s.q > 1.5 * (t.tot / 3.0)
GROUP BY a.alm_dsc ORDER BY skus_con_excedente DESC, a.alm_dsc ASC

),
dem AS (

  FROM vtadia v, c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.corte - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.corte GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
prop AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst,
    CEIL(COALESCE(d.u90,0) / 90.0 * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd

    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas30 AS (
  SELECT vta_art, SUM(vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia, corte
  WHERE vta_fch <= corte.f AND vta_fch > corte.f - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
),
riesgo AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_prv, p.prv_dte,
         COALESCE(s.total,0) AS total,
         COALESCE(v.u,0)/30.0 AS prom_diario
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN ventas30 v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true
)
SELECT r.art_cd AS sku
FROM riesgo r
WHERE r.prom_diario > 0 AND r.total / r.prom_diario < r.prv_dte
ORDER BY r.art_cd

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - INTERVAL '29 day' AND c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_prv, p.prv_nm, p.prv_dte,
         COALESCE(s.total,0) AS total,
         COALESCE(v.u30,0) / 30.0 AS prom_diario
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = TRUE
)
SELECT prv_nm AS proveedor, prv_dte AS dias, COUNT(*) AS skus_en_riesgo
FROM base
WHERE prom_diario > 0 AND total / prom_diario < prv_dte
GROUP BY prv_nm, prv_dte
ORDER BY skus_en_riesgo DESC, prv_nm ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS criticos
FROM artmst a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art) s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
WHERE COALESCE(s.stock,0) < a.art_ptr
AND a.art_crt = true
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))

),

base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, p.prv_nm, p.prv_dte,

  FROM artmst a

  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art),
ventas AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30 FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 30 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art)
SELECT a.art_cd, p.prv_pais, p.prv_dte, COALESCE(s.total,0) AS stock, COALESCE(v.u30,0) AS u30,
 COALESCE(v.u30,0)/30.0 AS prom_diario,
 COALESCE(s.total,0)/(COALESCE(v.u30,0)/30.0) AS cobertura
FROM artmst a JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true AND p.prv_pais = 'CN'
ORDER BY a.art_cd

WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stk FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art=a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
dem AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)::numeric/90 AS d FROM vtadia v, c WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 89 AND c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(q.qty * a.art_cst)::numeric, 2) AS monto, COUNT(*) AS skus
FROM artmst a CROSS JOIN c
JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd=a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art=a.art_cd
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CEIL(COALESCE(d.d,0)*CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty) q
WHERE s.stk < a.art_ptr
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art=a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stock AS (SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS stock_total FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd GROUP BY a.art_cd),
dem AS (SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und)/90.0 AS d90 FROM vtadia v, corte c WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 89 AND c.f GROUP BY v.vta_art),
prop AS (
SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_cst, a.art_crt, CEIL(COALESCE(d.d90,0) * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
FROM artmst a JOIN stock s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = a.art_cd
WHERE s.stock_total < a.art_ptr
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS numero FROM prop WHERE qty * art_cst > 100000

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u90
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - 90 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stk FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
),
prop AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr,
         COALESCE(s.stk,0) AS stk,
         CEIL(COALESCE(vt.u90,0) / 90.0 * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM artmst a
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN ventas vt ON vt.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE COALESCE(s.stk,0) < a.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qty*art_cst >= 50000 AND qty*art_cst <= 250000) AS gerente,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qty*art_cst < 50000) AS comprador,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qty*art_cst > 250000) AS director
FROM prop

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (

),

),
prop AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, a.art_ptr,
         COALESCE(s.stk,0) AS stk,
         CEIL(COALESCE(vt.u90,0) / 90.0 * CASE WHEN a.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM artmst a
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN ventas vt ON vt.vta_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE COALESCE(s.stk,0) < a.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = a.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)

WITH t AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS tot FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art HAVING SUM(exi_qty) > 0)
SELECT a.alm_dsc AS cedis, COUNT(DISTINCT e.exi_art) AS skus
FROM exidet e
JOIN t ON t.exi_art = e.exi_art
JOIN almmst a ON a.alm_id = e.exi_alm
WHERE e.exi_qty > 1.5 * (t.tot / 3.0)
GROUP BY a.alm_dsc
ORDER BY skus DESC, cedis ASC
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst) AS total_skus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst WHERE art_crt = true) AS criticos, (SELECT CEIL(0.2*COUNT(*)) FROM artmst) AS top_n

argumentos.sql:
WITH val AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) * a.art_cst AS valor
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
rk AS (
  SELECT art_cd, art_crt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY valor DESC, art_cd ASC) AS pos FROM val
),
clase_a AS (
  SELECT art_cd FROM rk WHERE art_crt = true OR pos <= (SELECT CEIL(0.2*COUNT(*)) FROM artmst)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clase_a

WITH t AS (SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS tot FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art HAVING SUM(exi_qty) > 0)
SELECT a.alm_dsc AS cedis
FROM exidet e
JOIN t ON t.exi_art = e.exi_art
JOIN almmst a ON a.alm_id = e.exi_alm
WHERE e.exi_qty > 1.5 * (t.tot / 3.0)
GROUP BY a.alm_dsc
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.exi_art) DESC, a.alm_dsc ASC
LIMIT 1

)

argumentos.sql:
WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (SELECT vta_art AS art, SUM(vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia, corte WHERE vta_fch > f - 30 AND vta_fch <= f GROUP BY vta_art),
stock AS (SELECT exi_art AS art, SUM(exi_qty) AS tot FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art),
riesgo AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd AS sku, COALESCE(s.tot,0) AS tot
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
  JOIN ventas v ON v.art = a.art_cd AND v.u > 0
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true AND COALESCE(s.tot,0) / (v.u / 30.0) < p.prv_dte
)
SELECT r.sku, r.tot, (SELECT string_agg(e.exi_alm::text || ':' || e.exi_qty::text, ' ') FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = r.sku) AS detalle,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = r.sku AND r.tot > 0 AND e.exi_qty > 1.5 * (r.tot / 3.0)) AS tiene_excedente
FROM riesgo r ORDER BY r.sku

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stk AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_ptr, a.art_cst,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd), 0) AS stock_total
  FROM artmst a
),
dem AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) / 90.0 AS d
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch >= c.f - 89 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
prop AS (
  SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_crt, s.art_cst,
         CEIL(COALESCE(d.d, 0) * CASE WHEN s.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM stk s
  LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd
  WHERE s.stock_total < s.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
),
niv AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN qty * art_cst < 50000 THEN 'comprador'
              WHEN qty * art_cst <= 250000 THEN 'gerente'
              ELSE 'director' END AS aprueba
  FROM prop
)
SELECT aprueba, COUNT(*) AS n FROM niv GROUP BY aprueba ORDER BY aprueba

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_ptr,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd), 0) AS stk
  FROM artmst a)
SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_crt, s.art_ptr, s.stk,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd) AS n_oc_total,
       (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT o.ocp_sts, ',') FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd) AS sts
FROM stock s
WHERE s.stk < s.art_ptr
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
ORDER BY s.art_cd

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocpcab) AS n_oc, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocpcab WHERE ocp_sts='PENDING_APPROVAL') AS pend, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocpcab WHERE ocp_sts='APPROVED') AS appr, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst WHERE art_ptr IS NULL) AS ptr_nulos, (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) FROM vtadia) AS corte

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (SELECT vta_art AS art, SUM(vta_und) AS u FROM vtadia, corte WHERE vta_fch > f - 30 AND vta_fch <= f GROUP BY vta_art),
stock AS (SELECT exi_art AS art, SUM(exi_qty) AS tot FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art),
riesgo AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd AS sku, COALESCE(s.tot,0) AS tot
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
  JOIN ventas v ON v.art = a.art_cd AND v.u > 0
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true AND COALESCE(s.tot,0) / (v.u / 30.0) < p.prv_dte
)
SELECT r.sku AS sku_con_excedente FROM riesgo r
WHERE r.tot > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = r.sku AND e.exi_qty > 1.5 * (r.tot / 3.0))
ORDER BY r.sku

WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
crit AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_prv FROM artmst a WHERE a.art_crt),
stk AS (SELECT k.art_cd, k.art_prv, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = k.art_cd),0) AS stock FROM crit k),
v AS (SELECT s.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(d.vta_und),0) AS tot FROM stk s CROSS JOIN c LEFT JOIN vtadia d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd AND d.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 29 AND c.f GROUP BY s.art_cd),
r AS (SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_prv, s.stock, v.tot, p.prv_nm, p.prv_dte FROM stk s JOIN v ON v.art_cd = s.art_cd JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = s.art_prv WHERE v.tot > 0 AND (s.stock * 30.0 / v.tot) < p.prv_dte)
SELECT prv_nm AS proveedor, prv_dte AS dias, COUNT(*) AS skus_en_riesgo FROM r GROUP BY prv_nm, prv_dte ORDER BY skus_en_riesgo DESC, prv_nm ASC LIMIT 10

v AS (SELECT s.art_cd, COALESCE(SUM(d.vta_und),0) AS tot FROM stk s CROSS JOIN c LEFT JOIN vtadia d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd AND d.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - 29 AND c.f GROUP BY s.art_cd),
r AS (SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_prv, s.stock, v.tot, p.prv_nm, p.prv_dte FROM stk s JOIN v ON v.art_cd = s.art_cd JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = s.art_prv WHERE v.tot > 0 AND (s.stock * 30.0 / v.tot) < p.prv_dte)
SELECT prv_nm AS proveedor FROM r GROUP BY prv_nm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, prv_nm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH c AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
crit AS (SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_prv FROM artmst a WHERE a.art_crt),

r AS (SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_prv, s.stock, v.tot, p.prv_nm, p.prv_dte FROM stk s JOIN v ON v.art_cd = s.art_cd JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = s.art_prv WHERE v.tot > 0 AND (s.stock * 30.0 / v.tot) < p.prv_dte)
SELECT prv_dte AS dias FROM r WHERE prv_nm = (SELECT prv_nm FROM r GROUP BY prv_nm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, prv_nm ASC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY prv_dte

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
stk AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_ptr, a.art_cst,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd), 0) AS stock_total
  FROM artmst a
),
dem AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) / 90.0 AS d
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch >= c.f - 89 AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
prop AS (
  SELECT s.art_cd, s.art_crt, s.art_cst,
         CEIL(COALESCE(d.d, 0) * CASE WHEN s.art_crt THEN 45 ELSE 30 END) AS qty
  FROM stk s
  LEFT JOIN dem d ON d.vta_art = s.art_cd
  WHERE s.stock_total < s.art_ptr
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocpcab o WHERE o.ocp_art = s.art_cd AND o.ocp_sts IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED'))
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM prop WHERE qty * art_cst < 50000
UNION ALL SELECT NULL WHERE FALSE

argumentos.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM artmst) AS skus, (SELECT count(*) FROM artmst WHERE art_cst IS NULL) AS cst_null, (SELECT count(*) FROM exidet WHERE exi_qty IS NULL) AS qty_null, (SELECT count(*) FROM exidet e LEFT JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd=e.exi_art WHERE a.art_cd IS NULL) AS huerfanos, (SELECT count(DISTINCT exi_art) FROM exidet) AS skus_con_exist

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS und
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE(s.stock,0) AS stock, vt.und,
         (vt.und / 30.0) AS vdp,
         COALESCE(s.stock,0) / (vt.und / 30.0) AS cob
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN ventas vt ON vt.vta_art = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true AND vt.und > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cob)::numeric, 1) AS cobertura,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cob < 7) AS menos_7,
       COUNT(*) AS n_skus
FROM base
SELECT MIN(vta_fch) AS minf, MAX(vta_fch) AS maxf, COUNT(*) FROM vtadia

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0)*a.art_cst AS valor
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
rk AS (
  SELECT art_cd, art_crt, valor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY valor DESC, art_cd ASC) AS r
  FROM stock
),
clase_a AS (
  SELECT s.art_cd, s.valor FROM stock s
  WHERE s.art_crt = true OR s.art_cd IN (SELECT art_cd FROM rk WHERE r <= CEIL(0.2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst)))
)
SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(valor) FROM stock), 2) AS valor_total,
       ROUND((SELECT SUM(valor) FROM clase_a) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(valor) FROM stock), 1) AS pct_clase_a,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clase_a) AS n_clase_a

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ven AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN c.f - INTERVAL '29 days' AND c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stk AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.exi_qty) FROM exidet e WHERE e.exi_art = a.art_cd),0) AS stock
  FROM artmst a
)
SELECT a.art_cd, p.prv_dte, s.stock, COALESCE(ven.u30,0) AS u30,
  COALESCE(ven.u30,0)/30.0 AS vdp,
  s.stock / (COALESCE(ven.u30,0)/30.0) AS cobertura
FROM artmst a
JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
JOIN stk s ON s.art_cd = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN ven ON ven.vta_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true AND p.prv_pais = 'CN'
ORDER BY a.art_cd

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0)*a.art_cst AS valor
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
rk AS (SELECT art_cd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY valor DESC, art_cd ASC) AS r FROM stock),
clase_a AS (
  SELECT s.valor FROM stock s
  WHERE s.art_crt = true OR s.art_cd IN (SELECT art_cd FROM rk WHERE r <= CEIL(0.2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst)))
)
SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(valor) FROM clase_a) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(valor) FROM stock), 1) AS pct_clase_a
SELECT ROUND(SUM(e.exi_qty * a.art_cst), 2) AS valor FROM exidet e JOIN artmst a ON a.art_cd = e.exi_art

WITH val AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd, a.art_crt, COALESCE(SUM(e.exi_qty),0) * a.art_cst AS v
  FROM artmst a LEFT JOIN exidet e ON e.exi_art = a.art_cd
  GROUP BY a.art_cd, a.art_crt, a.art_cst
),
rk AS (
  SELECT art_cd, art_crt, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC, art_cd ASC) AS r FROM val
),
clA AS (
  SELECT art_cd, v FROM rk WHERE art_crt OR r <= CEIL(0.2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artmst))
)
SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(v) FROM val)::numeric, 2) AS valor,
       ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT SUM(v) FROM clA) / (SELECT SUM(v) FROM val))::numeric, 1) AS pct_clase_a,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clA) AS n_clase_a

WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (
  SELECT v.vta_art, SUM(v.vta_und) AS u30
  FROM vtadia v, corte c
  WHERE v.vta_fch > c.f - INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.vta_fch <= c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(exi_qty) AS stock_total FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
)
SELECT a.art_cd AS sku, p.prv_dte, COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) AS stock, COALESCE(v.u30,0) AS u30,
       COALESCE(v.u30,0)/30.0 AS prom_diario,
       COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) / (COALESCE(v.u30,0)/30.0) AS cobertura
FROM artmst a
JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true AND p.prv_pais = 'CN'
ORDER BY a.art_cd

argumentos.respuesta: No puedo calcular las unidades en tránsito entre centros de distribución porque la base de datos no contiene esa información. Las tablas disponibles son: proveedores (prvmst), artículos (artmst), almacenes/CEDIS (almmst), existencias por artículo y almacén (exidet, con la existencia física actual en cada almacén), ventas diarias (vtadia) y órdenes de compra a proveedores (ocpcab). Ninguna registra traspasos o envíos en curso entre almacenes, y no existe una regla de negocio para "en tránsito" (la búsqueda de "tránsito", "traspaso" y "transferencia" no devolvió coincidencias). La existencia en exidet es stock en cada almacén, no mercancía en movimiento, y las órdenes de compra son de proveedores externos, por lo que no son un sustituto válido.
